mapper.select: SELECT id, candidate_key AS candidateKey, question FROM om_ai_target WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE om_ai_target target SET related_element_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_ai_object_target object_target WHERE object_target.target_candidate_id = target.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_ai_relation_target relation_target WHERE relation_target.target_candidate_id = target.id) WHERE target.task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_ai_object_target link JOIN om_ai_object candidate ON candidate.id=link.object_candidate_id WHERE link.target_candidate_id=#{targetId} AND candidate.del_flag=0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_ai_relation_target link JOIN om_ai_relation candidate ON candidate.id=link.relation_candidate_id WHERE link.target_candidate_id=#{targetId} AND candidate.del_flag=0)
